    Calendars

      Add a calendar

      Google Calendar, on a computer: Settings, pick the calendar, then copy "Secret address in iCal format".

      Apple Calendar: tap the ⓘ beside the calendar, turn on Public Calendar, then Share Link.

      Outlook: Settings, Calendar, Shared calendars, Publish a calendar, then copy the ICS link.

      Anyone with the link can read that calendar, so it is kept as a secret here and never shown again.

      Lists

      Open your lists on this phone, to add to them and check things off away from the frame.

        Make a list here

        Kept on your frame’s server, with no other account. Add to it at the frame or here.

        Connect Todoist

        In Todoist: Settings, Integrations, Developer, then copy your API token. It lets the frame show your lists and check things off.

        Connect Google Tasks

        You’ll sign in at Google and come straight back. Gingham asks only for your task lists.

        Connect Microsoft To Do

        You’ll get a short code. Enter it on Microsoft’s page and sign in there; your password never comes here.

        Open Microsoft’s page, enter this code, and sign in.

        Open Microsoft’s page

        Waiting for Microsoft…

        Disconnecting forgets the sign-in here. To take back Gingham’s access at Microsoft too, use Microsoft’s app access page; a work account’s administrator manages it there.

        Connect Nextcloud or Fastmail

        Nextcloud: your Nextcloud address, and an app password made in Settings, Security.

        Fastmail: https://caldav.fastmail.com, your email address, and an app password with calendar access, made in Settings, Privacy & Security.

        Synology: the address the Calendar app shows under CalDAV account. Any other server that speaks CalDAV works the same way.

        Use an app password rather than your main one. It is kept sealed on this server and never shown again.

        Connect Home Assistant

        In Home Assistant, open your profile, then Security, and create a long-lived access token at the bottom. Its to-do lists come here, and so do the ones it gets from other apps.

        If homeassistant.local doesn’t work, use its number address, like http://192.168.1.20:8123. A frame on a hosted server needs Home Assistant’s remote address instead.

        Choose the lists to show, in the order you want them.

            Photos

            Connect an album

            In Photos, open a shared album, tap the people icon, turn on Public Website, then Share Link. New photos added to the album appear on the frame within fifteen minutes.

            Frames

              Pair a frame

              Open this address on the frame. It shows a code: point this phone’s camera at it, or type its six characters here.

              Frame PIN

              Who can change this

                Open this on the other device within three days. It works once.

                Setup

                Open your setup link

                From your frame

                On the frame, open Settings, tap "Manage from a phone" and enter your household PIN. Point this phone’s camera at the code it shows, or type the code here.

                Or by link

                Open the setup link you were sent on this device, or ask someone who is already set up to add you from their "Who can change this".
